descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Company Overview 
 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.
 The Impact You Will Create 
You develop innovative features for our PLM platform (Product Lifecycle Management).
You actively shape the architectural design of our cloud-native infrastructure .
You support the continuous development of our systems with your expertise.
You work closely with our service providers .
 Experience And Skills You Will Need 
 Core Python & Frameworks : Strong proficiency in Python 3.x (OOP) and experience with web/backend frameworks such as Flask , Dash , or RESTful architectures .
Experience with React, CSS.
 Integration & Scripting : Experience in building REST APIs , automation scripts, and database connections (SQL, ORM).
 Containerization & Orchestration : Practical experience with Docker and container platforms like Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift .
 Cloud Environments : Hands-on expertise with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS or Azure).
 DevOps & APIs: Familiarity with building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI / GitHub Actions) and working with REST/OpenAPI architectures.
 PLM & Industrial Context : Understanding of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and integrations with systems like SAP or CAD.
 Agile Practices : Comfortable working in agile setups with strong technical documentation skills.
 Nice to have 
 Platform Expertise : Prior experience with the CONTACT Elements Framework or similar platforms for backend customization or workflow development, and low-code/Python extensions is a strong plus.
 Our Offer 
25 days annual leave + 1 day annual leave after 5 years in the company
Meal tickets
Additional health insurance
A good work life balance with flexible working time
A pleasant and diverse environment with regular events, team buildings and stimulating activities
A huge array of tools & technologies available on the spot and ready for a steady personal development
Variety of opportunities with one of the strongest and largest retail companies in the world
You will be part of an international team composed of people from different countries and backgrounds
Onboarding and support/mentoring
